load_basis: Synthetic hypotheses awaiting product telemetry, accepted protocol and measured GoDaddy capacity. Payload bytes exclude envelope, TLS, compression, presence, assets and retransmissions.
contention_candidate: 20 percent of valid writes target the same object within each board; remaining writes spread over 1000 objects. This is a synthetic hotspot, not a product conflict-resolution decision.
fault_corpus_candidate: 5 percent duplicate delivery with same logical ID
one board policy fence while other guild remains active
snapshot boundary and retained old-lineage receipt retry

budget_candidates.metric: same-client monotonic send-to-durable-ACK, all eligible new commands, after warmup
budget_candidates.conditions: baseline, target same-region RTT <=100ms; rejected/conflicting commands reported separately; lost/timeout samples remain in denominator

budget_candidates.metric: source send to accepted peer projection, instrumented shared clock uncertainty
budget_candidates.conditions: baseline; report clock error separately; do not subtract proxy/network time

budget_candidates.metric: user launch to authenticated usable accepted board
budget_candidates.conditions: cold/warm cache separate; <=2MiB initial board serialized data and <=1000 objects synthetic initial corpus

budget_candidates.metric: transport restored to converged accepted board
budget_candidates.conditions: after 30s offline, <=500 missed operations, drafts preserved; no false ACK

budget_candidates.metric: main-thread frame duration while editing/panning synthetic baseline board
budget_candidates.conditions: real desktop/mobile measured separately; background/PIP separate; no screen-reader performance inference

resource_candidates.note: Proposed baseline investigation thresholds, not hardware promises. Count throttles, conflicts, rejected abuse, timeouts, dropped offered work and generator saturation separately. Zero tolerance for unauthorized effects, acknowledged loss or cross-tenant disclosure.

accessibility_candidate.normative_target: All applicable WCAG 2.2 A and AA criteria, W3C Recommendation 2024-12-12; actual applicability/conformance review pending
accessibility_candidate.critical_task_budget: zero blockers for supported keyboard and AT tasks; no critical/serious automated findings left unexplained; automated scans alone cannot pass
accessibility_candidate.additional_design_goal: 44x44 CSS pixel outer controls, reduced motion and polite/coalesced live feedback; these are proposed design goals, not WCAG AA numeric requirements. Canvas two-dimensional reflow exceptions require documented review; surrounding UI remains testable.
